parts.meaning: The air fryer runs hotter than the dial says, because the fan pushes hot air straight onto the food. Dropping 25F keeps the edges from burning before the middles soften.
The fan cooks food about 20 percent faster than still oven air, so the air fryer time is four fifths of the oven time.
The check-at time is 70 percent of the oven time. Open the basket then and look for crisp edges.
Potatoes shrink as they cook. Shaking moves the buried pieces to the top, where the heat is strongest.

formula.text: Air fryer temp = oven temp minus 25F. Air fryer time = oven time × 0.8. Check at = oven time × 0.7. For potatoes at 425F for 30 minutes: 400F for 24 minutes, check at 21 minutes.

howToSteps.name: Read the oven settings
howToSteps.text: Find the temperature and time in your recipe. Potato wedges usually roast at 425F for 30 minutes.

howToSteps.name: Convert both numbers
howToSteps.text: Take 25F off the temperature and take 20 percent off the time. 425F for 30 minutes becomes 400F for 24 minutes.

howToSteps.name: Cut evenly and toss in oil
howToSteps.text: Cut the potatoes to a similar size and toss with a tablespoon of oil and salt.

howToSteps.name: Cook, shake, and check
howToSteps.text: Spread in a single layer and shake twice. Start checking at 21 minutes, and pull them when the edges are crisp.

title: Oven to Air Fryer: Roast Potatoes
tutorial: Potatoes are the most reliable side dish for an air fryer. Wedges that roast at 425F for 30 minutes air fry at 400F for 24 minutes, with crisp edges and fluffy middles. Start checking at 21 minutes.

Whole potatoes are the case where the converted time runs long. A whole russet that bakes for 60 minutes in the oven converts to 48 minutes, but the maker charts give 30 to 35 minutes at 400F in the air fryer. The small chamber heats a whole potato much faster than a big oven does. Check at the check-at time, test with a fork, and expect them done early.

Cut potatoes cook by size, and even pieces are the rule again. Wedges should be about an inch wide, and diced potatoes about an inch across. Sweet potatoes take longer than russets at the same size, because they are denser and hold more moisture. Give sweet potato chunks the full converted time, and check russets early.

Parboiling is the shortcut for the crispiest roast potatoes. Boil the chunks for five minutes, drain, and rough up the edges in the colander before they go in the basket. The rough edges crisp into the crunchy crust that makes roast potatoes worth the effort. Toss with oil and salt after the parboil, not before.

Shake twice, and do not crowd the basket. Potatoes piled two deep steam in the middle and only the top layer crisps. Two batches beat one crowded basket, and the second batch cooks faster because the fryer is fully hot.
